Awaran  is an administrative subdivision, (tehsil) of Awaran District in the Balochistan province of Pakistan. It is administratively subdivided into 2 Union Councils. The economy largely depends on subsistence agriculture and livestock rearing.
Demographics
}}
Population
According to the 2023 Census of Pakistan, Awaran Tehsil has a total population of 45,774. Of this population, 28,780 individuals (approximately 62.87%) reside in urban areas, while 16,994 individuals (approximately 37.13%) live in rural areas.
The tehsil covers an area of 13,075 square kilometers, resulting in a low population density of about 3.5 people per square kilometer.
The literacy rate in Awaran Tehsil stands at 42.90%, with a gender disparity: 50.90% literacy among males and 34.92% among females.
Religion
}}In the 2023 census, 252 (0.55%) people in the tehsil were from religious minorities, mainly Christians.
Language
At the time of the 2023 census, 99.76% of the population spoke Balochi.
